text.autoconfig.brbe.title: Better Recipe Book Configuration
text.autoconfig.brbe.option.enableBook.@: The recipe book is hidden when disabled.
text.autoconfig.brbe.option.expandedReci: New Recipe Book UI (Not Yet Finished)
A larger recipe book with a new UI layout. Not functional yet, but you can take a look.
Shows the source mod of an item, similar to Jade.
text.autoconfig.brbe.option.rbip.enableR: Aligns the vanilla recipe book tabs with the creative inventory. Reopen inventory to take effect.
text.autoconfig.brbe.option.hideIncompat: Hide 3x3 Recipe Marks in Survival Recipe Book
text.autoconfig.brbe.option.partialCraft: Removes the 'Show Craftable Only' button; craftable items will always be placed on the first page.
text.autoconfig.brbe.option.partialOnlyW: Only Show Incomplete Recipes While Carrying
Incomplete recipes will no longer always be shown. Pick up an item to show the incomplete recipes related to it, keeping the UI cleaner.
text.autoconfig.brbe.option.partialMarki: Recipes that have some materials in the inventory will be given a special texture.
text.autoconfig.brbe.option.settingsButt: §eTip: §eIf you disable the following two options, you'll need Mod Menu to re-enable them.
text.autoconfig.brbe.option.alternativeR: Show Alternative Recipes Only on Hover
Displays items instead of their recipes in the alternative list for easier viewing
text.autoconfig.brbe.option.newRecipes.e: Enables a small bounce animation when unlocking new items
text.autoconfig.brbe.option.showAllRecip: Show 3x3 Recipes in Survival Recipe Book
text.autoconfig.brbe.option.newRecipes.u: When enabled, automatically unlocks all recipes, allowing them to be viewed in the recipe book without discovery.
text.autoconfig.brbe.option.scrollAround: When reaching the end of the book, wrap around to the beginning (like JEI)
zzzbrbe.gui.tip.1: You can right-click the search bar to clear its text.
zzzbrbe.gui.tip.2: Press F (default) to pin the recipe under your cursor to the front page.
zzzbrbe.gui.tip.3: Incomplete recipes are those that have some materials in your inventory but cannot be crafted. Inspired by Bedrock Edition.
zzzbrbe.gui.tip.4: Using it with an item manager is also great — you can look up how to craft recipes and their uses in the recipe book (hotkeys follow your item manager). You can also hide the item manager's interface in "UI".
zzzbrbe.gui.tip.5: The creative mode tab feature comes from the Recipe Book is Pain mod!
zzzbrbe.gui.tip.6: Come say hi on social media and make some friends!
zzzbrbe.gui.tip.7: All code is generated by DeepSeek!
